selected_direction: Exact independently decodable I8 payload compression
disposition: No-go for a large new placement claim on sampled existing Q8 streams; not a theorem about every codec or quantization format.

mechanisms.name: Compressed row-shard lengths and physical page placement
mechanisms.necessary_work_change: Exact codec reduces physically fetched bytes before ECC and native-I8 MAC. This can invalidate a dense one-byte-per-weight NAND work lower bound.
mechanisms.model: T_chip >= max(28000*ceil(ceil(compressed_shard_bytes/16384)/4), physical_pages*2560, decoded_weight_bytes/R_decoder, useful_weights/R_MAC); metadata and independent-stream boundaries included.
mechanisms.actual_evidence: 99 complete frozen-placement row shards from three layers/three experts/chips0,8; independent16/64KiB raw/bitshuffle/zigzag Zstd3 frames. Deep/Qwen never reduce a single sampled ordinary wave; Mixtral summed sampled waves improve2.38/2.98%.
mechanisms.generic_vs_placement: Compare compressed g16 and compressed strongest projection using identical codec, metadata, decoder and capacity. Only further chip/page assignment or row splitting gains count as placement. Byte compression against uncompressed placement is generic prior benefit.
mechanisms.fastest_remaining_test: None justified without a new codec or representation showing substantially more redundancy. Shared-layer ANS could approach the measured symbol entropy but that alone is only about4/8.5/4% payload headroom, before page rounding. Zero-order entropy is not a universal conditional-entropy bound.
mechanisms.go_gate: Demonstrate >10% physical waves reduction across all selected chips/layers and >10% placement gain over equally compressed strong baseline, then synthesize/measure adequate decoder throughput and area.

mechanisms.name: Exact shared tile/base representation
mechanisms.necessary_work_change: Identical gate/up weight rows with the same x can be computed once; a shared exact base plus genuinely compressible residual could amortize work. Down inputs differ per expert, so weight sharing alone does not grant shared GEMV results.
mechanisms.actual_evidence: First-layer first64rows expert0 vsE/2 across gate/up/down: zero identical aligned Q8 blocks among65792. XOR delta entropy rises to7.93-7.95bits and Zstd residual grows3.66/8.96/3.67% relative to direct payload.
mechanisms.bound: For native-I8 arithmetic, an exact additive residual may require9bits. If residual coding is not smaller than direct coding, storing/reading the base adds work. Generic low-rank approximation is lossy and heavily covered by prior work.
mechanisms.fastest_remaining_test: Arbitrary permutation/deduplication not searched. Full-row exact repeats are unlikely given the negative aligned-block sample, but only a complete hash scan could prove absence. No large scan justified yet.
mechanisms.go_gate: Find substantial exact common submatrices under a scale-preserving permutation and include base/residual reads, extra GEMVs, activation dependencies and result combine costs.

mechanisms.name: Neuron/column permutation with selective precision or zero-column pages
mechanisms.necessary_work_change: Pack correlated optional residual bitplanes or co-zero input columns into actual NAND pages, allowing those pages to be skipped while a quality target is maintained.
mechanisms.bound: For down-only zero skipping the absolute whole-expert weight-work saving cannot exceed z/3 before page effects. With independent zero columns probability z and m columns/page, expected page-skip rate is z^m. For H2048 and a16KiB full-output column tile m=8; z=.5 yields only0.390625% down-page skips absent correlations.
mechanisms.prior_risk: SLIM/Apple-style neuron/page bundling, Atom/OA-LAMA reordering, Any-Precision/AnyBCQ bitplanes and PagedWeight expert precision paging already cover generic mechanisms. Mere migration to NAND is not sufficient novelty.
mechanisms.fastest_experiment: Capture actual post-SwiGLU expert activations on a bounded prompt subset; calculate page-all-zero or thresholded-page skip rates before writing a selector. Existing corpus stores routes, not activations, so routing cannot establish this headroom.
mechanisms.quality: Exact-F32 SiLU outputs rarely vanish; nativeA8 exact zeros or thresholding needs a fresh numerical baseline. For lossy precision/thresholds run a fixed public QA/math/code quality suite and perplexity; token agreement alone is not quality.
mechanisms.go_gate: Show a material gap over same-quality SLIM/Any-Precision/PagedWeight-like baseline caused specifically by NAND page/WL constraints and coupled gate/up/down permutation.

quantization_boundary.interpretation: Per-row INT8 requantization of dequantized Q8 changes weights by about0.8-1.0% relativeL2 in the sampled rows, improves entropy to7.0-7.2bits, but is not lossless and model quality is untested. Existing Q8 no-go must not be extrapolated to all future nativeINT8 quantization schemes.

priors.name: APack
priors.scope: Lossless fixed-point quantized weights, distribution-adaptive arithmetic coding, parallel Verilog encoder/decoder at memory controller; direct generic-compression baseline.

priors.name: Huff-LLM
priors.scope: End-to-end compressed weights with near-PE Huffman decoding; published GF12 synthesis and area overhead. Its FP weight codecs and throughput cannot be assigned unchanged to this INT8 AiF datapath.

priors.name: Approaching Shannon Bound with Lossless LLM Weight Compression
priors.scope: Independent tile-addressable ANS substreams, layer-wide codebook and offset table, decode fused with GEMM, includes INT8/group-quantized formats. Independent expert tiles are not novelty.

priors.name: Near-memory NMT Huffman decompression
priors.scope: Author-hosted IEEE Access 2023 paper describes quantized/Huffman weights decoded in near-HBM logic; confirms near-memory decoder placement predates this study. Second university mirror timed out.

priors.name: Any-Precision LLM
priors.scope: ICML2024 bit-plane representation for multiple quantization widths in one stored model.

priors.name: AnyBCQ
priors.scope: ICLR2026 hardware-friendly direct bit-plane operations and request-level precision selection.

priors.name: PagedWeight
priors.scope: July2026 runtime quality-aware MoE expert-weight quantization and page management. Direct strong prior to optional precision pages.

priors.name: Atom
priors.scope: MLSys2024 activation/weight reordering for efficient mixed-precision execution; permutation and outlier separation are established.

priors.name: LorExperts and BTExperts
priors.scope: 2026 local dominant experts plus low-rank corrections and shared-computation trees. Generic shared low-rank corrections are not an unexplored mechanism.

priors.name: PARSER residual sparsification
priors.scope: 2026 expert output-aware sparse residual compression; generic shared-base/residual mechanisms are established.
